control_failures.control_label: integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: unplanned release of chemical energy at K-7301

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas on K-7301, PT-7301 and ZV-7212 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining hazardous-area electrical equipment, specifically inspecting Ex equipment and enclosures. K-7301 (vapour recovery compressor) is in service for loading vapour recovery. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas had degraded below its design intent. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 4 January 2014 a hazard report was recorded on K-7301, PT-7301 and ZV-7212 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during a statutory inspection; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
